anchor: v1::Leila Haddad, order ORD-20602. The 65L backpack came with a ripped hip belt, clearly from shipping. Refund please.

result.text: I'm sorry the backpack arrived with a ripped hip belt. Because the item is $260, the system requires a human agent to review damage claims at that value, so I couldn't start the refund myself. I've sent your claim for order ORD-20602 to our team as ticket ESC-4102, and they'll respond within 1 business day. I can't guarantee the refund amount until they've reviewed it.

toolCalls.name: mcp__store__create_return
toolCalls.output: Return refused: Damage claims of $200 or more need review by a human agent. Escalate with category "damage_claim" and do not promise a refund. Use escalate_to_human instead.

input.summary: Leila Haddad (guest) reports the Expedition 65L backpack ($260, delivered 2026-09-27, unopened) arrived with a ripped hip belt from shipping damage and is requesting a refund. The automatic return was refused because damage claims of $200 or more require human review.
